source.kind: Installed official Garmin Connect IQ device packages

fields.resource_palette_colors: compiler.palette.colors when present; not inferred from bitsPerPixel

scope_note: The 35 product IDs match the requested scope of reference-face-configurable. All capability data below was read independently from official installed device metadata; no build or runtime dependency on that face. Product support is distinct from simulator, store export or physical-device validation.
api_note: Regional part numbers may advertise API 1.3.1. The manifest minimum of 1.4.0 excludes those regional firmware versions; a product ID is not a claim that every region or firmware is supported.
resource_note: White official logos on black; four gray levels where supported. Screen width 208 and launcher sizes shared with 8-color MIP use only black and white. Launcher dimensions are independent of screen width.
